message.content: {"claims":[{"quote":"Our target customers are adults aged 10 to 68 who travel by ferry."},{"quote":"Our target customers are adults aged 46 to 48 who travel by ferry."},{"quote":"Once live, a QR ticket wallet will cut support calls by 40%."},{"quote":"Once live, a seat picker will cut support calls by 51%."},{"quote":"Launching a QR ticket wallet will double repeat bookings within a year."},{"quote":"12% of commuters miss the last sailing on Pier 4 to Gull Island."}],"needs":[{"quote":"Tickets should feel instant."}],"stories":[{"quote":"As a day visitors traveller, I want to be told of a delay so that I can rebook."},{"quote":"As a commuters traveller, I want to buy a return ticket for Old Quay to Heron Point so that I can plan one trip."},{"quote":"As a ticket inspector, I want to scan a code so that I can confirm a booking quickly."},{"quote":"As a school parties traveller, I want to buy a return ticket for Northgate to Saltmarsh so that I can plan one trip."},{"quote":"As an operator, I want to export sailings so that finance can reconcile them."}],"dependencies":[{"quote":"The service must meet the port authority's accessibility bylaw 4."},{"quote":"Delivery depends on the harbour CCTV vendor, with no named owner yet."},{"quote":"Sam Okoro on the port authority's berth API will confirm the schedule feed by June."},{"quote":"Sam Okoro on the payments gateway team will confirm the schedule feed by June."}]}
